parsed.main_gap: A local algebraic error states lcm(m,n)=mn/g²; it should be mn/g. The subsequent product update P'=P/g is nevertheless correct.

errors.description: The displayed identity for the least common multiple is false. Since gcd(m,n)·lcm(m,n)=mn, one has lcm(m,n)=mn/g, not mn/g². Correcting this exponent makes the stated conclusion P'=P/g valid.

parsed.notes: Apart from this readily repairable typo/inconsistency, the lexicographic descent proves termination and the primewise gcd-of-valuations invariant correctly determines the unique terminal value.
